experiment_eval.original_intent: Find BBWAA Hall of Fame ballot records in the Player category from 1936 through 1940 that received at least 150 votes.

turns.user_query: Which BBWAA Player-category Hall of Fame ballot records from 1936 through 1940 received at least 150 votes?
turns.agent_reply:
There were 18 qualifying records:

1936: Ty Cobb (cobbty01), 222 votes; Babe Ruth (ruthba01), 215; Honus Wagner (wagneho01), 215; Christy Mathewson (mathech01), 205; Walter Johnson (johnswa01), 189. Each had 226 ballots, needed 170 votes, and was inducted.

1937: Nap Lajoie (lajoina01), 168 votes; Tris Speaker (speaktr01), 165; Cy Young (youngcy01), 153. Each had 201 ballots, needed 151 votes, and was inducted.

1938: Pete Alexander (alexape01), 212 votes, inducted; George Sisler (sislege01), 179, not inducted; Willie Keeler (keelewi01), 177, not inducted; Eddie Collins (collied01), 175, not inducted. Each had 262 ballots and needed 197 votes.

1939: George Sisler (sislege01), 235 votes, inducted; Eddie Collins (collied01), 213, inducted; Willie Keeler (keelewi01), 207, inducted; Rube Waddell (wadderu01), 179, not inducted; Rogers Hornsby (hornsro01), 176, not inducted; Frank Chance (chancfr01), 158, not inducted. Each had 274 ballots and needed 206 votes.

No 1940 record met the criteria.

evaluation.user_intention: For precisely the National League award winners retained in the preceding step, report each player's total recorded salary, total award-ballot points, and 1936 Hall of Fame vote total.
evaluation.expected_sql: SELECT P.PLAYER_ID, P.NAME_FIRST, P.NAME_LAST, SA.TOTAL_RECORDED_SALARY, VA.TOTAL_POINTS_WON, H.VOTES AS HALL_OF_FAME_VOTES FROM THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_HALL_OF_FAME H JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER P ON H.PLAYER_ID = P.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER_AWARD A ON A.PLAYER_ID = P.PLAYER_ID JOIN (SELECT S.PLAYER_ID, SUM(S.SALARY) AS TOTAL_RECORDED_SALARY FROM THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_SALARY S GROUP BY S.PLAYER_ID) SA ON SA.PLAYER_ID = P.PLAYER_ID JOIN (SELECT V.PLAYER_ID, SUM(V.POINTS_WON) AS TOTAL_POINTS_WON FROM THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER_AWARD_VOTE V GROUP BY V.PLAYER_ID) VA ON VA.PLAYER_ID = P.PLAYER_ID WHERE (P.PLAYER_ID) IN (SELECT P1.PLAYER_ID FROM THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_HALL_OF_FAME H1 JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER P1 ON H1.PLAYER_ID = P1.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_SALARY S1 ON S1.PLAYER_ID = P1.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER_AWARD A1 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = P1.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER_AWARD_VOTE V1 ON V1.PLAYER_ID = P1.PLAYER_ID WHERE (P1.PLAYER_ID) IN (SELECT P2.PLAYER_ID FROM THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_HALL_OF_FAME H2 JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER P2 ON H2.PLAYER_ID = P2.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER_AWARD A2 ON A2.PLAYER_ID = P2.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_PLAYER_AWARD_VOTE V2 ON V2.PLAYER_ID = P2.PLAYER_ID JOIN THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_SALARY S2 ON S2.PLAYER_ID = P2.PLAYER_ID WHERE (P2.PLAYER_ID) IN (SELECT H3.PLAYER_ID FROM THEHISTORYOFBASEBALL_HALL_OF_FAME H3 WHERE H3.YEARID = 1936 AND H3.VOTEDBY = 'BBWAA' AND H3.CATEGORY = 'Player' AND H3.VOTES >= 170) AND H2.YEARID = 1936 AND H2.VOTEDBY = 'BBWAA' AND H2.CATEGORY = 'Player' AND H2.INDUCTED = 'Y' AND H2.BALLOTS >= 200 GROUP BY P2.PLAYER_ID) AND A1.LEAGUE_ID = 'NL' GROUP BY P1.PLAYER_ID) AND H.YEARID = 1936 AND H.VOTEDBY = 'BBWAA' AND H.CATEGORY = 'Player' AND A.LEAGUE_ID = 'NL' ORDER BY SA.TOTAL_RECORDED_SALARY DESC, P.PLAYER_ID ASC
